sentence_stem: If I had studied harder for the exam,
correct_completion: I would have passed it easily.
full_sentence: If I had studied harder for the exam, I would have passed it easily.
acceptable_variants: I might have passed it more easily.
I would have got a better grade.

options.text: I passed it easily last year.
options.why_wrong: The past simple does not fit the result clause of a third conditional, which needs 'would have' followed by a past participle.

options.text: I will pass it easily tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' refers to the future, but the third conditional describes an unreal situation in the past.

options.text: I would have passed it easily.
I would pass it easily now.
options.why_wrong: This refers to the present, but the if-clause describes a past situation that did not happen.

grammar_focus: Third conditional: 'if' + past perfect, then 'would have' + past participle
explanation: The if-clause uses the past perfect to describe an unreal past situation, so the main clause must use 'would have' with a past participle to describe the imagined result.
translation: Sınava daha çok çalışsaydım, onu kolayca geçerdim.
